question: What will come in place of ? to satisfy the equation : (√6-1)² =?-2√6
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Square the term (√6 − 1) directly using the identity (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b².

LHS = (√6)² − 2(√6)(1) + 1² = 6 − 2√6 + 1 = 7 − 2√6

Equate this to the RHS:

7 − 2√6 = ? − 2√6

? = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**
